title: Sum of Factorials from 1 to N

content.problemStatement:
Print the sum of factorial form 1 to n.
1!+2!+.....+n!=?

solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Maintain the current factorial in each loop iteration and add it to total sum.

hints: Each factorial term can be derived from the previous: fact *= i.
Add each factorial term to a running sum.
learningObjectives: Reuse computed values across loop iterations (dynamic programming concept).
